cases.note: empty lines are not rows but they are lines: the report counts them
a feed whose first line is not exactly the header is refused with 400 and nothing is loaded
a refused feed changes nothing: the report of the earlier load stays
an id that is already stored keeps the row it first had, even when another feed sends it differently
a corrected file under the same name replaces the report and loads the rows that were refused
a feed where every row is bad loads nothing, and a feed of empty lines has no rows
a feed never loaded has no report
the first line of an id that is already stored is existing, and a later line of the same id is a duplicate
six copies of one file arrive at the same moment: all are answered, and every purchase is stored once
two feeds with the same 30 ids, one in ascending and one in descending order, arrive in turn eight at a time: none is refused
42.50 of groceries earns 85 and 30.00 of fuel 45; 18.90 of dining earns 56.7, rounded down to 56
the second dinner starts at 95.00 of the month: 5.00 at 300% and 15.00 at 200%
a member nobody bought for is unknown, and so is one whose every row was refused
a purchase of nothing earns nothing and still makes a member
each purchase is rounded down on its own: two of 1.50 earn 1 and 1, not 3
right at the edge of a band: 200.00 of groceries fills the first band, and the next cent is paid at 100%
one purchase that covers every band of its category: dining 850, travel 2150, fuel 375
the bands start again with each calendar month, and with each year
a category and a member keep their own running totals: ana and ben earn the same, and cy crosses a band

cases.note: purchases of one day are taken in the order of their ids as plain text: P10 comes before P9
a purchase that arrives late is placed by its date: the total is what the month's order gives
sending a purchase again, in the same file or another, does not earn it twice
the largest amount a feed can hold, without losing a cent to a float
a member's points add up every month they bought in
the partner answers: both members are reconciled with their bonus
the partner is down: every lookup is tried three times, the run still ends with 200, and both members are pending
one failure is retried after a pause, and the second try gets the bonus
two failures and then an answer: the third try is the last one, and it is enough
a lookup that gets no answer within 1 s is given up on, three times, and that member is pending while the others finish
a 429 with Retry-After: 1 is waited for, and then asked again
a 403 is not going to change: it is asked once, and that member is pending
a member the partner has no record of (404) has a bonus of 0, and is reconciled: nothing to retry
a 200 answer that is cut off is a failure like any other: retried
a 200 answer without a bonus is a failure too, and after three tries the member is pending
a pending member is asked again by the next run, a reconciled one is not
one member's lookups keep failing: only that member is pending, and the others are not held up
running the reconciliation again when everyone is reconciled asks the partner nothing
a month must be written YYYY-MM with a month from 01 to 12
a month nobody bought in has nothing to reconcile and asks the partner nothing
before any reconciliation a statement is open: the month's points, no bonus; a month with no purchases is 0
a lookup that was too slow once is tried again, and the second try is enough
a bonus is separate from what purchases earn: the points of a member do not change
only the members who bought in the month are asked: April has ana alone
the whole partner is down for three members: the run still ends normally, and every member is pending
